Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for Citrobacter freundii (>100,000 CFU/mL), indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria is noted. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Glucosuria is slightly above normal. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
